t: You're standing on Holborn Viaduct, a road bridge that is also the name of the street crossing it. It opened in 1869 and links Holborn, by way of Holborn Circus, with Newgate Street in the City. Beneath you it passes over Farringdon Street and the buried River Fleet, spanning the steep valley. It's 1,400 feet long and 80 feet wide. William Haywood, the City Surveyor, was the architect, and Rowland Mason Ordish was the engineer. Haywood also served as engineer to the City's Commissioners of Sewers.
